# Pinned Chromium revision for Halcyon integration.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for which Chromium revision the
# Halcyon integration patches in patches/ target. The patches are
# generated by scripts/generate_patches.py against this revision.
#
# To build Halcyon:
#   1. Check out Chromium at the SHA below.
#   2. Apply the Halcyon source tree (rsync halcyon/src/ into the
#      Chromium src/ tree).
#   3. Apply the patches in patches/ in the order documented in
#      patches/README.md.
#   4. Run `gn gen out/Halcyon --args='...'` with enable_halcyon=true.
#   5. Run `ninja -C out/Halcyon chrome`.
#
# To re-pin to a newer Chromium revision:
#   1. Update this file with the new SHA + version + date.
#   2. Update PINNED_SHA and PINNED_VERSION in scripts/generate_patches.py.
#   3. Run `python3 scripts/generate_patches.py` to regenerate the patches
#      against the new revision.
#   4. Run `bash scripts/verify_patches.sh` to confirm the new patches apply.
#   5. If any patch fails to apply, fix the replace_once() call in the
#      generator script that targets the shifted line.

# The full 40-character SHA-1 of the pinned Chromium commit.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_SHA=ff897141277d798d72ea3ae0a94ff3a51956b267

# The Chromium version string (MAJOR.MINOR.BUILD.PATCH) at that SHA.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_VERSION=159.0.8142.0

# The branch the SHA was on at pin time.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_BRANCH=main

# The date the pin was made (ISO 8601, UTC).
HALCYON_PIN_DATE=2026-11-04T00:00:00Z

# The short SHA (12 characters) for display.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_SHA_SHORT=ff897141277d
